# Claude Platform release notes — captured 2026-08-10
# Source: https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/release-notes/api
# (the two sources.json Anthropic URLs still 404 — see errors table)

### August 7, 2026  — newest dated entry; all four reported 2026-08-09
- Session budgets for Claude Managed Agents: a hard cap on a session's spend, priced at public list
  rates. A session that reaches its budget pauses with the `budget_reached` stop reason instead of
  starting new model requests; changing or removing the budget resumes it. Deployments accept the
  same budget and apply it to each session they start.  /docs/en/managed-agents/budgets
- Session advisor: a model at least as capable as the agent's own that the session's primary thread
  can consult mid-turn for strategic guidance. Configured as a `{"type": "advisor"}` entry in the
  agent's multiagent roster, naming the `model` to consult.
  /docs/en/managed-agents/multiagent-orchestration#give-the-session-an-advisor
- `inference_geo`: control where model inference runs for a Managed Agents agent. Set inside the
  `model` object at agent creation, or override per session.  /docs/en/manage-claude/data-residency
- Skills from GitHub: when a Managed Agents session mounts a repository, any skills in its root
  `.claude/skills` directory are discovered automatically at session start and are available to the
  agent for that session.  /docs/en/managed-agents/skills#load-skills-from-a-github-repository

### August 5, 2026  (reported 2026-08-07)
- Inference hooks beta for Claude Enterprise.
- Claude Opus 4.1 retired.

### August 1, 2026
- Dreams (research preview) now supports Claude Opus 5.  [below reporting bar — model support add]

### July 2026 and earlier
Unchanged: Opus 5 (Jul 24), mid-conversation tool changes, `fallbacks` "default" mode, Opus 4.7
fast-mode removal, Managed Agents `effort` + environment/memory-store webhooks + `initial_events` +
thread event deltas (Jul 22), Workbench sunset (Jul 17), mid-conversation system messages (Jul 15),
Claude Enterprise Admin API user management (Jul 14), Dreams model adds + Access Transparency
`cmek_preserve` detail (Jul 10), API key expiration (Jul 8), `agent-memory-2026-07-22` header
(Jul 2), Fable 5 / Mythos 5 restored (Jul 1).

Anthropic News (https://www.anthropic.com/news): unchanged — newest is Aug 7 "Improving Fable 5's
biology safeguards" (safeguard change, not a new capability) and Aug 4 Chief Global Affairs Officer
appointment. Then Jul 30 cybersecurity-evaluation incidents post, Jul 27 open-weights position, Jul
27 Cognizant partnership expansion. No new product surface.

Standing coverage note: keep watching /docs/en/managed-agents/* (agents, sessions, memory stores,
environments, vaults, webhooks, tunnels) — fast-moving and under-covered here.

Updated: 2026-08-10 — no change. Newest release note is still August 7; no August 8, 9 or 10 entries.
